key.name: panel-limit
key.summary: Limit shown in the top bar
key.description: "session" (short window, e.g. 5-hour), "weekly_all" (weekly), or "auto" for the most used one. Applies to every account.

key.name: panel-icon
key.summary: Top bar icon: provider logo (falls back to the ring if missing) or progress ring

key.name: stats-range
key.summary: Usage range shown in the menu

key.name: show-remaining
key.summary: Show what is left instead of what is used

key.name: panel-countdown
key.summary: Time until reset in the top bar: on the account closest to its limit, on every account, or off

key.name: panel-accounts
key.summary: Accounts in the top bar: all, or only the one closest to its limit

key.name: hidden-accounts
key.summary: Account ids ("claude", "openai") hidden from the top bar, menu and notifications

key.name: menu-account
key.summary: Account tab last opened in the menu

key.name: notify-enabled
key.summary: Notify when a limit is running low

key.name: notify-warn-left
key.summary: Warn when this percentage or less is left

key.name: notify-critical-left
key.summary: Urgent notification when this percentage or less is left
